name: Mining MANIA! 🧨
desc:
Race, mine, explore, BOOM! 🧨⛏️

Make the BIGGEST explosions, race your friends, get rich, and test your luck mining for rare ores! 💎

🏁 Race your friends and win crazy items! Who will find diamonds?
💣 Destroy ores with lightning, TNT, fireballs, and more!
⭐ Level up and upgrade to become a stronger miner!
🍀 Test your luck searching for rare ores! Is RNG on your side?
🌍 Explore different worlds as you mine deeper!
🖼️ Search for rare ores for your museum!
🍌 Collect over 50 items to trap your friends in funny ways!

🔔 Turn on notify! Don't miss out on new CRAZY blocks!

💖 Thanks for all the support! Like and favorite for more!
